title: Center Operations Standard for Customer-Pay Repairs: Turnaround, Same-Day Work, Post-Repair Scan and Calibration Check
content:
Customer-Pay Repairs jobs run through Crestline centers against four per-tier production settings: the target time from drop-off to ready, whether the job can be done the day the vehicle is dropped off, whether a post-repair diagnostic scan is run before ready, and whether the job is checked against the manufacturer's calibration requirements.

## Production settings by tier

| Service tier | Target business days from drop-off to ready | Same-day service | Post-repair diagnostic scan before ready | Calibration check, with resulting calibration orders closed before ready |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paintless Dent Repair Service | 1 | Yes | No | No |
| Cosmetic Touch-Up Service | 1 | Yes | No | No |
| Bumper Refinish Service | 2 | No | Yes | Yes |
| Panel Repair Service | 4 | No | Yes | Yes |
| Customer-Pay Collision Service | 10 | No | Yes | Yes |
| Complete Refinish Service | 15 | No | No | No |

## Defined terms

- **Target turnaround**: Target business days from drop-off to ready (integer).
- **Same-day service**: Whether the job can be done the day the vehicle is dropped off (boolean).
- **Post-repair scan**: Whether a post-repair diagnostic scan is run before ready (boolean).
- **Calibration check**: Whether the job is checked against the manufacturer's calibration requirements and resulting calibration orders must be closed before ready (boolean).

## Notes

- Same-day service is available only in the Paintless Dent Repair Service and the Cosmetic Touch-Up Service, the two tiers with a 1 business day target.
- Bumper Refinish Service, Panel Repair Service and Customer-Pay Collision Service run both the post-repair scan and the calibration check; the other three tiers run neither.
- The turnaround figures are targets counted in business days; Complete Refinish Service carries the longest target, 15 business days.
